what: Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons, redistributed as TopoJSON by the world-atlas project. The Storm Atlas plate draws this as its CONTEXT tier -- South America, Africa, Canada, everything the archive's landfall rule never looks at -- in place of a third-party raster tile service. It is context and only context: no landfall, rate, cohort or refusal consults it.

sources.licence: Natural Earth: public domain. world-atlas redistribution: ISC (see LICENSE-world-atlas).

not_used_for: landfall detection, cohort membership, any published count, rate, interval or refusal
